description: This file contains functions and type definitions for sending direct messages and group messages, including handling media content, within the Urbit/Tlon platform. It interfaces with external APIs and constructs message stories with optional media attachments.

methods.name: sendDm
methods.description: Sends a direct message by converting text to a story and dispatching it via the API.

methods.name: sendDmWithStory
methods.description: Sends a direct message with a pre-constructed story object, creating a unique message ID and poking the chat API.

methods.name: sendGroupMessage
methods.description: Sends a group message by converting text to a story and dispatching it via the API.

methods.name: sendGroupMessageWithStory
methods.description: Sends a group message with a pre-constructed story object, handling thread reply formatting and poking the channels API.

methods.name: buildMediaText
methods.description: Constructs message text with optional media URL, combining them if both are present.

methods.name: buildMediaStory
methods.description: Builds a story array with text and optional media content, adding image blocks or links as appropriate.
